name: Storage quota estimate
plain: Reports how much storage the origin may use, which tracks total disk size.
meaning: Chrome and Safari set the quota near 60% of total disk, so quota reveals disk size within a few GB, and Incognito shows a much smaller number. Also usage shows how much the site has already stored.

access.persistence: read fresh on every page load; nothing stored
access.iframe: Readable from cross-origin iframes too (same values)

fields.name: quota
fields.precision: Chrome adds small noise and bucketing in some versions

limits.headline: Can see how much storage the site may use, which tracks your disk size
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens when the page loads
can: See the storage quota, about 60% of total disk in Chrome and Safari
See how much the site has already stored
Guess your disk size class from the quota
Spot a private window from its smaller quota
cannot: Be exact; numbers have noise and rounding

story.what_it_is: Tells a site how much storage it may use, which is tied to your disk size.

marketing.name: Storage for the web
marketing.pitch: web.dev explains how sites can ask how much space they may use and plan around it.

story.for_you: You never see it. A site that stores big offline files, like a game or movie, can ask how much room it has so it does not fail. The answer also says something about your disk size.
story.for_makers: Apps that work offline need to know whether a download will fit. The quota is around 60 percent of the disk in some browsers, so it leaks disk size. Private windows show a smaller number, which is why some sites also use it to spot private mode.

use_cases.example: A browser game with large offline assets checks storage space before downloading the next level pack.
A streaming site checks room before letting you save a movie for offline viewing.
An offline first notes or email web app checks space before saving mailbox data.
A browser video editor checks space before caching large clips.
A fraud tool compares the quota size with the claimed device to spot mismatches.
A news site detects tiny quotas that suggest private mode and applies its free article limit.
A fingerprint vendor uses the quota as a stable disk size hint.

technical_bounds: Quota is per origin policy, not raw disk size

history.change: Origin quota up to 60% of total disk for browser apps
Incognito quota reduced and disguised to hamper detection
